craft_notes: Sthāyin: all-I (sarvatrāsmīti — the I-am spreading everywhere THEN left). Sanskrit: vihāya nijadehasthaṃ sarvatrāsmīti bhāvayan...sukhī bhavet → L4 keeps leaving-then-seeing-none sequence. Rows: row 3 (gaze→happy may be). Close: may be (optative — happiness as granted, not asserted). Rejected: 'omnipresence-practice' — killed: I-am-thus kept as the contemplation (it IS everywhere-I-am-thus); 'selfish' — no: it's abandoned for standing.

lines: firm mind, gaze seeing none else — happy may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vihāya nijadehasthaṃ sarvatrāsmīti bhāvayan | dṛḍhena manasā dṛṣṭyā nānyekṣiṇyā sukhī bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What happiness comes from leaving body? → All-pervading self-contemplation with single gaze makes happy.
c1_essence: Everywhere-I-am-thus: gaze seeing none else, happy.
